entities.summary: Juraj Biankini was a journalist and Croatian and Yugoslavian politician. He moved to Zadar to attend high school and theological seminary. In 1871, Biankini became the editor of the Zadar-based Narodni list at urging of Mihovil Pavlinović, the leader of the Croatian National Revival in Dalmatia. He retained the position until 1918. Biankini's work helped the newspaper attain a leading position in the region.
